nodes.label: Optimizador PC working context (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: WPF desktop app in PowerShell 5.1 compiled to a portable .exe with ps2exe. State: complete UI plus bounded real changes; three mechanisms touch the machine (registry, commands, deletion), each with its own allowlist.

nodes.label: Registry write via allowlist (SettingApply -> Writer)
nodes.rationale: The app runs elevated, so writes only go through an allowlist of branches and concrete values ($RegistryWriteAllowlist), respect the declared type, keep the previous value in memory ($RegistrySnapshots), verify by re-reading and support -WhatIf. Toggle ON writes Recommended, OFF writes Default. Widening the allowlist is a security decision, not a detail (read SECURITY.md first).

nodes.label: One setting per registry key (never group keys)
nodes.rationale: Each -Registry setting maps to exactly one key (today the 47 of Regedit). README status rules still describe multi-key settings (optimized/factory only if all keys agree), a path this policy leaves unused.

nodes.label: Command-step sections (Internet, Limpieza, Energia)
nodes.rationale: A section that declares Steps instead of Items is a checklist of commands plus a run button, ported one command per step from loose scripts (Reiniciar_Red_v3.cmd, EliminarTemporales.v1.cmd, maximo rendimiento de enerigia.bat). Execution order is the file order whatever the user ticks, because steps depend on each other. Use Test-CategoryHasSteps: @($null).Count is 1. Tests disarm execution and never touch the network.

nodes.label: Never an interpreter (no cmd /c, no powershell -c)
nodes.rationale: Executables start directly by full system path, each argument a separate -Arguments element; pipes or 'if errorlevel' from the .cmd become other step types (services use -Service, which checks Get-Service).

nodes.label: Command allowlists ($CommandAllowedExecutables / $CommandAllowedServices)
nodes.rationale: Adding an executable or service is a security decision (SECURITY.md section 12); Security.Tests.ps1 fails if a step does not pass the allowlist.

nodes.label: Step-run queue (120 ms DispatcherTimer, state in $StepRun)
nodes.rationale: The window never freezes: each tick does ONE thing (close the finished step, follow the pause, start the next); .cmd pauses become -PauseAfter. Without a message loop the timer never ticks, so tests call Invoke-StepRunTick by hand. State lives in $StepRun, not in controls, so Sync-StepRunPanel shows the same after a language switch or leaving and returning mid-run.

nodes.label: ContentDock: fixed frame for the step-run panel
nodes.rationale: A fixed slot above the scrolling area in the content column; placed in the header it pushed the sidebar. Set-PageDock fills it, Clear-PageHeader empties it.

nodes.label: Command output read as bytes, decoded afterwards
nodes.rationale: netsh writes UTF-8 when launched from a 65001 terminal and OEM 850 from the console-less .exe.

nodes.label: Admin gating of steps (-RequiresAdmin, effective selection)
nodes.rationale: Meant to run elevated; without rights, steps needing them are unticked, disabled, flagged and kept out of the queue. In Internet only three work without rights - verified, not assumed (nbtstat -R fails yet returns 0). Effective selection = Test-StepSelected (ticked AND Test-StepAvailable). Tests force elevation with Set-AppElevationOverride.

nodes.label: Folder cleanup (FolderCleanup.ps1, the only place that deletes files)
nodes.rationale: Empties profile temp folders and the recycle bin through a folder allowlist, in chunks, inside the user folder; -Clean and -EmptyRecycleBin default to -RequiresAdmin $false.

nodes.label: Guides section (Guias, ui/Data/Guides .md)
nodes.rationale: One card per .md; adding a guide = dropping the .md and recompiling (the .exe embeds them). Content belongs to the user and never passes through T (Set-PageBreadcrumb -RawTitle / -BackView); only the frame is translated.

nodes.label: Markdown reader subset (Get-MarkdownBlocks)
nodes.rationale: Understands what the guides use, not all CommonMark. Own decision: inside a paragraph a line starting with ** opens a new line. Named Get-MarkdownBlocks because ConvertFrom-Markdown exists in PowerShell 7. A RichTextBox keeps the mouse wheel, so Send-MarkdownWheel forwards it to the page.

nodes.label: Parameter-name case pitfall ([string]$Title vs $title)
nodes.rationale: PowerShell variables are case-insensitive: a [string]$Title parameter turns any inner $title into text. It broke every breadcrumb at once in Set-PageBreadcrumb.

nodes.label: OptimizadorPC.exe: portable, elevated, console-less (-requireAdmin -noConsole)
nodes.rationale: Any real tweak runs elevated, so be conservative. Without a console Write-Host is invisible: debug by running main.ps1.

nodes.label: SECURITY.md (threat model and contracts)
nodes.rationale: Living security document cited by CLAUDE.md and README.md: read before touching registry writes; section 4 security-degrading settings, section 12 command allowlist.

nodes.label: Security and quality audits (auditoria/ dated reports)
nodes.rationale: Each pass leaves a dated report in auditoria/ and a row in auditoria/README.md to record what was reviewed and fixed; SECURITY.md is the living document, reports are snapshots.

nodes.label: Seven-layer architecture (one folder per layer)
nodes.rationale: From data to screen; never skip a layer downward; the folder name says what may be inside. A view creating controls by hand belongs in Components; a component knowing concrete categories by Id belongs in the category file.

nodes.label: Layer 1 Base: ui/Design (Theme, UiKit)
nodes.rationale: Below everything: any layer uses them, they use nobody.

nodes.label: Layer 2 Mechanism: ui/Engine
nodes.rationale: Register, translate, save and route. No data and no controls.

nodes.label: Layer 3 Policy: ui/Index (the main files)
nodes.rationale: What is shown, in what order, what is locked. No content.

nodes.label: Layer 4 System: core/ (talks to Windows)
nodes.rationale: Does not know the UI (not one WPF control), returns data and never throws upward. Split by what it touches in Windows: Registry, Interop (Mica/Acrylic, work-area maximize), Shell (http/https links only), Commands, Diagnostics. A new mechanism (services, power) is a new subfolder that enters the .exe on its own.

nodes.label: Layer 5 Data: ui/Data (declarations only)
nodes.rationale: Categories/, Preferences/, Lang/: one file per section, option and language; zero UI code.

nodes.label: Layer 6 Pieces: ui/Components
nodes.rationale: Build concrete controls and do not know the views; split by what each piece draws (Shell, Cards, Layout).

nodes.label: Layer 7 Screens: ui/Views
nodes.rationale: Only assemble pieces; no loose New-Object of controls.

nodes.label: Components/Shell: the window frame
Components/Cards: the cards
Components/Layout: page pieces
Layer load order decided by main.ps1
nodes.rationale: Each layer loads whole via an @@EMBED_DIR block, so a new .ps1 enters on its own. main.ps1 only decides the order of the seven loads, which matters because data registers on load (Categories call Register-Category in Engine). Inside a folder order is alphabetical and irrelevant: the index decides the visible order. A test guards the inter-layer order.

nodes.label: Locked is not decorative (IsEnabled = $false on the controls panel)
nodes.rationale: New-SettingCard -Locked disables the controls panel and WPF stops delivering the mouse to the whole subtree; new controls on the setting card must hang from that panel to inherit the lock.

nodes.label: Test suite (tests/Run-Tests.ps1 -BothHosts, no Pester)
nodes.rationale: No dependencies: Windows ships Pester 3.4, incompatible with modern syntax. Folders: Harness (TestKit Describe/It, AppHost loads the app without the window, Fixtures), Core (against the real registry), Ui (WPF without showing the window), Source (rules read from code: BOM, closures, glyphs, what enters the .exe). AppHost reads main.ps1 with the same markers and order as build.ps1. Touch tests with the code; most is walked from the indexes.

nodes.label: Test on both hosts (5.1 .exe and pwsh 7 main.ps1)
nodes.rationale: The .exe (global scope, 5.1) and main.ps1 (script scope, pwsh 7) behave differently; some bugs show in only one. -BothHosts runs both in parallel with one approval; they share nothing because the Fixtures registry branch and the Rules.Tests combined script carry the PID.

nodes.label: Normalize-PsEncoding PostToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: Leaves each .ps1/.xaml in UTF-8 with BOM and CRLF on write. It lives in OptimizadorPC/.claude/settings.local.json, so a session opened from Escritorio\Temp does not load it (2026-10-03: new .ps1 files lost the BOM, caught by Rules.Tests.ps1), nor agents or permissions. Open the session from OptimizadorPC/. sed -i keeps the BOM but leaves LF.

nodes.label: How to work fast here (ordered time-savers)
nodes.rationale: Independent calls go in the same turn; tests with -BothHosts; encoding fixed by the hook; skills at start. The real brake is permissions: a command missing from .claude/settings.local.json stops the session, so repeated read-only commands belong in that list.

nodes.label: Skills load at task start (break-ui render.ps1 as screenshot)
nodes.rationale: Skills enter the turn without cold start: windows-desktop-architect for UI, powershell-engineer for any .ps1, exploracion for reading, versionado for commits, review-animations for motion, break-ui for worst-case data; break-ui's render.ps1 paints a piece to PNG without opening the window.

nodes.label: Agent delegation policy (only for 2+ independent fronts)
nodes.rationale: An agent starts cold and must rediscover the project, so for one or two files it costs more than doing it. Delegate only with two or more fronts that do not touch each other, launched at once; Claude decides alone.

nodes.label: graphify graph: what it is for and what not
nodes.rationale: Useful: path/explain on code symbols, graph.html, god nodes Set-TextFg(), T(), Window. Not useful: natural-language query, how-it-works questions, finding where things go, data files (loose nodes; grep them). Queries failed because no edge linked docs and code. Order: CLAUDE.md, direct search, then the graph. The graph ages silently: run /graphify . --update after code changes.

nodes.label: build.ps1 embed markers (@@EMBED_DIR / @@EMBED_GUIDES / @@EMBED_XAML)
nodes.rationale: Only three markers, closed by @@ENDEMBED@@: folders (recursive), guides (each .md as Register-Guide (ConvertFrom-GuideBase64 ...), Base64 because free text could break a here-string; dev and AppHost call Import-GuideFolder; Rules.Tests checks round-trip), and the XAML as a literal here-string. No way to include a loose file: a hand-made dot-source works in dev and fails compiled, and a test forbids it. main.ps1, build.ps1 and AppHost use the same order (-Recurse, Sort-Object FullName). Never edit the generated build/_combined.ps1.

nodes.label: UTF-8 with BOM for every .ps1 and .xaml
nodes.rationale: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a BOM-less script as Windows-1252: mojibake and parser errors ('Token inesperado'). pwsh 7 assumes UTF-8, so a file can parse in 7 and break in 5.1; always verify with 5.1 and write with UTF8Encoding($true), never Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 from pwsh 7.

nodes.label: No .GetNewClosure() in event handlers (pass data via Tag)
nodes.rationale: A closure binds the handler to a dynamic module where script functions are invisible ('Show-CategoryDetailView is not recognized' on click); hidden in the .exe because ps2exe keeps functions global. Put the data in the control's Tag and get the window with [Window]::GetWindow($s); never capture a loop variable.

nodes.label: Colors only via theme resources (DynamicResource / Set-TextFg ...)
nodes.rationale: A literal #RRGGBB does not follow light/dark. Background properties are not interchangeable: Border (Set-BoxBg), Panel (Set-PanelBg), Control/window (Set-WinBg), shape fill (Set-ShapeFill); the wrong one fails silently.

nodes.label: Frozen brushes (Set-AppTheme mutates or replaces via Resources.Add)
nodes.rationale: WPF freezes shareable brushes on XAML load; Set-AppTheme first sets $brush.Color and replaces only frozen ones, with Resources.Add() because the indexer stores the PSObject wrapper and WPF rejects it with a misleading 'not a valid value for Foreground'.

nodes.label: Never declare an animated Freezable in a style Setter
nodes.rationale: RenderTransform/Effect in a Setter are shared by all controls of the style and WPF cannot animate a shared instance: create them per control in code (Add-HoverLift). The press-scale may live in a Setter because the trigger sets it, it does not animate it.

nodes.label: Glyph catalog (Segoe Fluent Icons), never emoji
nodes.rationale: Check a new codepoint with GlyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap and look at it rendered: E7ED is a crossed-out bell, the plain bell is EA8F.

nodes.label: Sidebar built by code from NavigationIndex
nodes.rationale: MainWindow.xaml only gives the Sidebar Border, empty NavTop/NavBottom and NavIndicator; Build-Sidebar creates buttons registered as Nav<Id>. An entry without View does not navigate on purpose (Set-NavSelection exits early) instead of a filler view. Selection is set by Sync-NavSelection from Show-View, not by the click, since screens can be reached without the menu.

nodes.label: Sidebar collapse animates the Border width, not the Grid column
nodes.rationale: The Auto column follows the Border; WPF has no GridLength animation. The 1px right border goes to 0 or the width never reaches zero. README: 220 ms CubicEase, 88 px to 0, content fades slightly earlier.

nodes.label: All visible text goes through T (source-text keyed translation)
nodes.rationale: English is the source and translation is by original text, not key. A literal without T stays English and never appears in Get-MissingTranslations - a silent failure. XAML cannot call T: its texts are set in TitleBar.ps1.

nodes.label: Router: Show-View and language repaint (Update-UiLanguage)
nodes.rationale: Views are shown with Show-View, never called directly, or the router loses track and a language change repaints the wrong screen. Colors follow DynamicResource but text does not: Update-UiLanguage rebuilds the menu and redraws the current view, deferred to the Dispatcher because it fires from a control in the view being destroyed.

nodes.label: Preferences persist via Set-AppSetting (%APPDATA% settings.json)
nodes.rationale: Never next to the .exe: it is portable and may sit in a folder without write permission. A corrupt JSON is ignored and defaults are used.

nodes.label: @() over a New-Object List[object] throws (use .ToArray())
nodes.rationale: Fails in 5.1 and 7 because New-Object returns a PSObject wrapper; List[string], ArrayList or ::new() work, so it only bites in some places. foreach, pipeline and returning it work.

nodes.label: Comma inside method parentheses separates arguments (-f pitfall)
nodes.rationale: $list.Add('{0} de {1}' -f $a, $b) keeps only the first value; build the string first. Calling a command is fine because there the parentheses wrap an expression.

nodes.label: Add-HoverLift stationary wrapper (RenderTransform moves the hit area)
nodes.rationale: Lifting a card moves it away from the cursor and loops MouseLeave/MouseEnter forever. The listener is a stationary Transparent wrapper (Uid 'lift') holding the margin, cursor and click; scale-only effects are safe.

nodes.label: Selectable text: read-only TextBox instead of TextBlock (New-MonoField)
nodes.rationale: TextBlock has no selection; a borderless transparent read-only TextBox looks the same but supports Ctrl+C. Foreground is the same DependencyProperty for both (Set-TextFg works), Background is not (hence Set-WinBg). The copy notice shows on one button at a time via module state because a DispatcherTimer has no Tag.

nodes.label: Two color families: Get-Palette and $GradientTokens
nodes.rationale: Each gradient is composed of two palette keys, never own colors, so no color is written twice and Set-AppTheme repaints both, gradients stop by stop. Get-ThemeKeys is the full key list checked by the rule-9 test; Get-GradientKey falls back to the flat key, letting New-IconTile paint any section accent.

nodes.label: Staggered entry never moves the card wrapper (Get-EnterTarget)
nodes.rationale: Start-StaggeredEnter delays each child; Get-EnterTarget moves the inner card when the child is the Add-HoverLift wrapper (Uid 'lift'), else the hit area would enter the rule-21 loop. A test guards it. README: 45 ms apart, 300 ms each.

nodes.label: Sliding indicator needs measurements (Move-NavIndicator)
nodes.rationale: TranslatePoint is zero before WPF measures (main.ps1 paints the first screen before the window exists), so the indicator hides and returns via SizeChanged, hooked once (flag in the Border Tag). It animates only on navigation, since collapse fires SizeChanged dozens of times.

nodes.label: Live backdrop at 20 fps without BlurEffect
nodes.rationale: Blobs blur themselves with radial gradients ending in transparent; a big blur over half the screen is the costly part. Timeline::SetDesiredFrameRate caps at 20 fps: nobody tells 20 from 60 over a half-minute path, and repainting the whole window nonstop is unacceptable in a program called Optimizador PC.

nodes.label: Mica/Acrylic and the own gradient are mutually exclusive
nodes.rationale: System material only shows on a translucent window, which can no longer have its own background, so WindowMaterial.ps1 swaps one for the other; it is a preference, off by default. The dwmapi call in core/Interop never throws: unsupported returns $false and surfaces stay opaque. Applied in SourceInitialized, when a handle exists.

nodes.label: Tests never touch the user's settings, network or registry
nodes.rationale: AppHost redirects $AppSettingsPath to a PID-named temp file, else a test would rewrite settings.json with a single key (the harness never calls Import-AppSettings). The Wiring.Tests probe, a copy of main.ps1 in another process, gets the redirection injected before its Import-AppSettings (it used to change the user's theme). The harness disarms commands (Set-CommandRunArmed $false) and pauses.

nodes.label: List or grid is a view option, not a separate view
nodes.rationale: OptimizationsListView reads the 'grid' option and picks panel (StackPanel/WrapPanel) and piece (CategoryCard/CategoryTile); both share New-CategoryStats so they never count differently. In grid the description has a fixed height so rows do not jag.

nodes.label: Start-CountUp writes the final value without a live window
nodes.rationale: Without a message loop the timer never ticks and the number would stay at zero in tests. README: pills count up in 520 ms.

nodes.label: core/ never throws upward (read / missing / denied / badpath)
nodes.rationale: A missing or forbidden key is an answer, not an error: a state is returned and the UI paints it. An escaping exception would bring the window down.

nodes.label: DWord arrives as signed Int32 (Format-RegistryValue)
nodes.rationale: 0xFFFFFFFF reads as -1; reinterpret unsigned or high values look negative and do not match the declared ones.

nodes.label: Always open RegistryView::Registry64
nodes.rationale: A 32-bit .exe would silently redirect HKLM\SOFTWARE to Wow6432Node.

nodes.label: Computed setting status (optimized / factory / custom / unknown)
nodes.rationale: Computed, not declared: SettingStatus.ps1 compares the read Current with each key's Recommended and Default, so a -Registry setting carries no -Tags. Compared by value (0x0000000A = 10; -1 = 0xFFFFFFFF); absent value = factory; nothing declared = unknown, never custom; Recommended = Default gives factory. Computed where read (Update-CategoryRegistryState, on entry and Refresh); the UI only reads Status and Get-StatusStyle owns colors and names.

nodes.label: Summary pills are a status filter
nodes.rationale: Pills combine; none selected shows all, with a 'Show all' pill otherwise. $CategoryStatusFilter is per section Id for the session and hides built cards by their Tag. Toggling a switch does not reapply it (the card would vanish under the mouse); arriving from search clears it.

nodes.label: Every registry/service change must be reversible (Default + snapshot)
nodes.rationale: The registry contract is each key's Default (where OFF returns) plus Writer.ps1's in-memory snapshot of the previous value. Pending: persist the snapshot and expose undo; today it is lost on close.

nodes.label: Security-degrading settings must be declared (never plain Recommended)
nodes.rationale: Settings lowering UAC, Defender, SmartScreen, Windows Update or BitLocker must say which protection is lost and cannot be on by default; Security.Tests.ps1 checks no -Registry touches those value names undeclared (SECURITY.md section 4).

nodes.label: Activity log (registro de actividad, core/Diagnostics/Log.ps1)
nodes.rationale: Every registry read leaves a line; the title-bar button opens the drawer. Log.ps1 stores facts, not sentences (English status words translated only when painted), so core/ ignores languages. Log lines are deliberately untranslated (technical text to copy), a conscious exception to rule 15. Circular buffer ($AppLogCapacity = 1000), at most $LogPanelMaxRows painted. Read-RegistryValue only times and logs; the raw read is Read-RegistryValueRaw.

nodes.label: The log drawer is not a view (Close-LogOverlay)
nodes.rationale: It sits on top of the screen without going through Router.ps1, so Update-UiLanguage rebuilds it separately (Show-CurrentView does not). Collapsing the veil lives in Close-LogOverlay, not the animation handler, because animations do not advance without a painted window: separating it makes closing testable.

nodes.label: Saving the log to a file (Guardar como, Export-AppLog)
nodes.rationale: Writes the whole buffer, not the painted rows. The dialog is split in three (New-LogSaveDialog builds, Read-LogSaveResult interprets - cancel is $null -, Save-AppLogTo writes) because a modal cannot be tested. Get-AppLogFileName suggests opt-<date>.log without colons. Folder remembered as LogSaveFolder via Set-AppSetting, falling back to the real Desktop (inside OneDrive). Empty log: Update-LogSaveButton disables the button and Export-AppLog refuses anyway (guarantee in core/). 'With detail' (LogExportDetails) indents detail lines; format [date] [LEVEL] [SOURCE] [status] via Format-AppLogLine.

nodes.label: Log entry detail (Items) folded with New-DetailList
nodes.rationale: Lines shown on request: files a cleanup deleted or skipped (Get-CleanupItems), recycle-bin contents, full program output (Get-CommandOutputItems), under the log entry and the step row. Open state lives in $DetailListOpen by key (log:<Id>, step:<section>:<step>) because the log is rebuilt and would close itself; entry Ids never repeat.

nodes.label: Sync-LogView: new log lines are not painted by themselves
nodes.rationale: Write-AppLog records in core/ and nobody notifies the UI; the drawer hides it (Show-LogPanel rebuilds on open) but the detached window would go stale, so whoever reads the system notifies (today Show-CategoryDetailView, next to Reset-SearchIndex). Sync-LogView rebuilds nothing without new entries (compares Get-AppLogSequence and count), since it runs each tick.

nodes.label: Detached log window (LogWindow.ps1, New-LogContent)
nodes.rationale: One function builds the content for drawer and window so they cannot drift. Built by code because build.ps1 embeds only ONE xaml. Owner = main window (closes with it, usable despite ShowDialog; no owner in tests). Theme via MergedDictionaries. A code-created window has no NameScope and RegisterName throws, so set one first.

nodes.label: Update-UiNow is a DoEvents (make the window deaf during reads)
nodes.rationale: Yields so the progress bar paints during a synchronous read, but WPF delivers mouse events meanwhile: set $Window.Content.IsHitTestVisible = $false or a click navigates away mid-read. Unneeded if reading moves to another thread.

nodes.label: Global search (flat index in ui/Engine/Search.ps1)
nodes.rationale: One entry per section and per setting with a lowercase Haystack; partial, case-insensitive all-terms match. Asks Get-OptimizationCategories, so new sections enter by themselves. Cached; dropped by Reset-SearchIndex on registry read and language change. Indexes translated AND original text; technical text never translated; joined lists translated item by item (New-SearchListField) before joining.

nodes.label: Search box Tag belongs to the popup, not the placeholder
nodes.rationale: New-SearchBox hides its placeholder by looking among siblings to keep Tag free, because New-SearchBar stores its Popup there; two owners of one slot break one of them.

nodes.label: Typing repaints the body, never the header
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding the header destroys the text box with its focus and caret: Show-SearchResultsView paints both, Update-SearchResults only the body, and the count goes in the body.

nodes.label: Search popup: debounce, Enter, Escape, reopen on click
nodes.rationale: First rows ($SearchPopupMax), Enter goes to the full page, Escape only swallowed if something was open, debounce ($SearchDebounceMs). Reopening on click needs GotFocus AND PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown because most of the window is not focusable and the box may never lose focus. Programmatic focus (Set-SearchFocus) is flagged once by $SearchFocusIsProgrammatic.

nodes.label: Popup opening deferred via Dispatcher.BeginInvoke ($script:SearchReopenBox)
nodes.rationale: Opening inside the triggering mouse event flickers: StaysOpen's outside-click hook sees the still-routing click. Request-SearchPopupReopen defers with BeginInvoke (Input priority). A scriptblock cast to [action] loses local variables, so $Box would arrive empty and Update-SearchPopup silently do nothing; the box travels via $script:SearchReopenBox, like Start-SearchDebounce with $script:SearchPendingBox.

nodes.label: Test popups by popup.Child, not IsOpen
nodes.rationale: IsOpen creates its own Windows window only with a shown window, which no test has, so the property does not stick; Update-SearchPopup rebuilds Child before touching IsOpen.

nodes.label: Clicking a result opens its section with the setting highlighted
nodes.rationale: New-SettingCard -Highlight adds an accent border; the scroll into view is deferred to the Dispatcher because Show-View scrolls to the top after the view finishes.

nodes.label: AppInfo.ps1: single source of the version
nodes.rationale: Read by the title bar, the ? panel and build.ps1; bumping the version is changing it there.

hyperedges.label: Three allowlisted mechanisms that touch the machine
Testability without a shown window (no message loop)
PowerShell language traps that misbehave silently
